en.t: Henry I of England marries Matilda of Scotland, the daughter of Malcolm III of Scotland and a direct descendant of the Saxon king Edmund Ironside; Matilda is crowned on the same day
en.s: Malcolm III (Middle Irish: Máel Coluim mac Donnchada; Scottish Gaelic: Maol Chaluim mac Dhonnchaidh; died 13 November 1093) was King of Alba (Scotland) from 1058 to 1093. He was later nicknamed "Canmore" (Scottish Gaelic: ceann mòr, lit. 'big head', understood as "great chief"). Malcolm's long reign of 35 years preceded the beginning of the Scoto-Norman age.

zh.s: 马尔科姆三世（中古爱尔兰语：Máel Coluim mac Donnchada；苏格兰盖尔语：Maol Chaluim mac Dhonnchaidh；1093年11月13日逝世）于1058年至1093年担任阿尔巴国王（苏格兰国王）。他后来获得“卡那摩尔”称号（苏格兰盖尔语：ceann mòr，意为“大头”，也被理解为“伟大领袖”）。他长达35年的统治开启了苏格兰—诺曼时代。

en.s: The Battle of Kratzau occurred on 11 November 1428 between an Imperial Silesian army and the Sirotci Hussites in Kratzau, Bohemia. During the battle, the Imperial Silesian army under Hans von Polenz overpowered the Hussite troops. In November 1428, the Hussites under the leadership of Jan Královec launched a campaign from the occupied Kratzau of Friedland and Ostritz to Löbau. The city was not taken by the Hussites, and so they retreated back to Kratzau. Silesian and Lusatia troops pursued the Hussites, defeating them near Kratzau. The loss of vehicles with rations was essential for the Hussites, since supplies were intended for units besieging the Lichnice Castle.

zh.s: 1428年11月11日，西里西亚帝国军与胡斯派孤儿军在波希米亚的克拉察乌交战。汉斯·冯·波伦茨率领西里西亚帝国军击败了胡斯派部队。此前，扬·克拉洛韦茨率领胡斯派从占领的克拉察乌、弗里德兰和奥斯特里茨出发，向洛鲍展开攻势，但未能攻下该城，随后撤回克拉察乌。西里西亚和卢萨蒂亚军队追击并在克拉察乌附近击败了胡斯派。胡斯派运粮车队被缴获，对方原本要为围攻利赫尼采城堡的部队运送补给。

en.s: The Great Stand on the Ugra River (Russian: Великое стояние на Угре) or the Standing on the Ugra River, also known as the Battle of the Ugra, was a standoff in 1480 on the banks of the Ugra River between the forces of Akhmat Khan of the Great Horde, and Grand Prince Ivan III of the Grand Duchy of Moscow.

en.s: The Treaty of Granada (1500), signed on 11 November 1500, was a secret treaty between Ferdinand II of Aragon and Louis XII of France, in which they agreed to partition the Kingdom of Naples. Drawn up in the context of the wider Italian Wars, the disputes between the Hispanic Kingdoms and France led to the treaty's collapse in 1503.

zh.s: 《格拉纳达条约》（1500年）于1500年11月11日签署，是阿拉贡国王费尔南多二世与法国国王路易十二之间的一项秘密条约，双方约定瓜分那不勒斯王国。该条约是在意大利战争背景下签订的。西班牙诸王国与法国之间的争端最终导致条约于1503年失效。

en.s: The siege of Rouen was an unsuccessful attempt by Henry IV of France to capture Rouen, the historical capital city of Normandy. The battle took place as part of the French Wars of Religion, the Eighty Years' War, and the Anglo–Spanish War (1585–1604). Although he had claimed the throne in 1589, Henry, a Huguenot, was not recognized by many of his Catholic subjects. He was forced to fight against a Catholic League determined to resist his rule, and which was aided by Spain. The siege began on 11 November 1591 with Robert Devereux, 2nd Earl of Essex confronting the town's governor, André de Brancas, Seigneur de Villars, "with the sort of chivalric gesture which still was made on Europe's battlefields" and "challenged Villars to meet him in individual combat."

zh.s: 法国国王亨利四世试图攻占诺曼底历史首府鲁昂，但未能成功。围城战发生在法国宗教战争、八十年战争和英西战争（1585—1604年）期间。亨利于1589年宣称继承王位，但许多天主教臣民不承认他这位胡格诺派国王。他被迫与坚决反对其统治、并得到西班牙援助的天主教联盟作战。围城战于1591年11月11日开始；第二代埃塞克斯伯爵罗伯特·德弗罗在城外与守军指挥官安德烈·德布朗卡斯（维拉尔领主）相遇，按当时欧洲战场上仍沿用的骑士礼仪，向对方提出单独决斗。

en.s: The Battle of Khotyn or Battle of Chocim, also known as the Hotin War, took place on 11 November 1673 in Khotyn, where the forces of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth under the Grand Hetman of the Polish Crown John Sobieski defeated Ottoman Empire forces, with Moldavian and Wallachian regiments, led by Hüseyin Pasha.

zh.s: 霍京战役（也称乔齐姆战役或霍廷战争）于1673年11月11日在霍京发生。扬·索别斯基统率波兰立陶宛联邦军，击败了侯赛因帕夏率领的奥斯曼帝国军队；奥军中还包括摩尔达维亚和瓦拉几亚团。

en.s: The siege of Larache, in 1689, was undertaken by an army of Morocco under 'Alawid Sultan Ismail Ibn Sharif against the Spanish forces of Charles II, which had ruled the city for almost 80 years since its cession in 1610. After three months of siege, the defenders were forced to capitulate.

en.t: The F.H.C. Society, also known as the Flat Hat Club, is formed at Raleigh Tavern, Williamsburg, Virginia. It is the first college fraternity
en.s: The F.H.C. Society, also known by its backronym "The Flat Hat Club", is a collegiate secret society and honor society at the College of William & Mary in Williamsburg, Virginia. Founded in 1750, the F.H.C. Society is the United States' oldest collegiate secret society. The F.H.C. Society remains active; while its operations remain highly secretive, the society's activity is apparent through campus philanthropy.

zh.t: F.H.C.学会（又称“扁帽俱乐部”）在弗吉尼亚州威廉斯堡的罗利酒馆成立，是首个大学兄弟会
zh.s: F.H.C.学会也以反向首字母缩写“扁帽俱乐部”闻名，是弗吉尼亚州威廉斯堡威廉与玛丽学院的大学秘密社团和荣誉社团。该学会成立于1750年，是美国历史最悠久的大学秘密社团。学会至今仍在活动；尽管运作高度保密，其校园慈善活动仍为人所知。

en.s: The Battle of Amritsar, also known as the Battle of Gohalwar, was fought between the Durrani Empire and Shaheedan Misl of the Dal Khalsa on 11 November 1757. Following the fourth invasion of Ahmad Shah Durrani, his army was attacked by Sikh bands under the command of Ala Singh and Baba Deep Singh. Following the attacks, Ahmad Shah desecrated the Sikh holy site known as the Shri Harmandir Sahib in Amritsar.

zh.s: 阿姆利则战役（又称戈哈尔瓦尔战役）于1757年11月11日爆发，交战双方是杜兰尼帝国与达尔卡尔萨旗下的沙希丹米斯尔。艾哈迈德·沙阿·杜兰尼第四次入侵后，他的军队遭到阿拉·辛格和巴巴·迪普·辛格率领的锡克武装袭击。袭击之后，艾哈迈德·沙阿亵渎了锡克教圣地哈曼迪尔·萨希卜。

en.s: The Cherry Valley massacre was an attack by British and Haudenosaunee (Iroquois) forces on a fort and the town of Cherry Valley in central New York on November 11, 1778, during the American Revolutionary War. It has been described as one of the most horrific frontier massacres of the war. A mixed force of Loyalists, British soldiers, Senecas, and Mohawks descended on Cherry Valley, whose defenders, despite warnings, were unprepared for the attack.

zh.s: 美国独立战争期间，英国军队和豪德诺索尼人（易洛魁人）于1778年11月11日袭击了纽约州中部樱桃谷的一座堡垒和当地城镇。这起事件被称为战争中最惨烈的边疆屠杀之一。效忠派、英国士兵、塞内卡人和莫霍克人组成的混合部队攻入樱桃谷。尽管事先得到警告，当地守军仍未做好应战准备。

en.s: The Action of 11 November 1779 was a minor naval engagement between the British Royal Naval frigate HMS Tartar and the Spanish frigate Santa Margarita off Lisbon during the Anglo-Spanish War. On 11 November, Captain Alexander Graeme in Tartar, belonging to the squadron under Commodore George Johnstone, was off Lisbon when he sighted the Spanish 38-gun frigate Santa Margarita. Tartar, with the wind behind her, caught up and engaged the Spanish vessel. After around two hours of fighting Santa Marguerita was almost dismasted when her captain decided to strike her colours. Santa Margarita was added to the Royal Navy under her existing name as a 12-pounder 36-gun frigate.

zh.s: 1779年11月11日的海战是英西战争期间的一次小规模海战，交战双方是英国皇家海军护卫舰“鞑靼号”和西班牙护卫舰“圣玛格丽塔号”，地点在里斯本外海。当天，亚历山大·格雷姆船长指挥的“鞑靼号”隶属乔治·约翰斯通准将的舰队，在里斯本附近发现西班牙一艘装备38门火炮的护卫舰。借助顺风，“鞑靼号”追上并与之交战。约两小时后，“圣玛格丽塔号”几乎桅杆尽失，其舰长决定降旗投降。该舰随后以原名编入英国皇家海军，成为一艘装备36门12磅炮的护卫舰。

en.s: The siege of Negapatam was the first major offensive military action on the Indian subcontinent following the arrival of news that war had been declared between Great Britain and the Dutch Republic, beginning the Fourth Anglo-Dutch War. A British force besieged the Dutch-controlled port of Negapatam, the capital of Dutch Coromandel, on the eastern coast of India, which capitulated after the fortification's walls were breached.

zh.s: 内加帕特南围城战是英荷战争爆发消息传到印度次大陆后，英国发动的第一次重大进攻行动。荷兰共和国和英国开战，引发第四次英荷战争。英军围攻了印度东海岸荷兰控制的港口内加帕特南，该地是荷属科罗曼德尔的首府；防御工事城墙被攻破后，守军投降。

en.s: The Battle of Dürenstein (German: Schlacht bei Dürnstein; also known as Dürrenstein, Dürnstein and Diernstein), on 11 November 1805, was an engagement in the Napoleonic Wars during the War of the Third Coalition. Dürenstein (modern Dürnstein) is located in the Wachau valley, on the river Danube, 73 kilometers (45 mi) upstream from Vienna, Austria. The river makes a crescent-shaped curve between Dürnstein and nearby Krems an der Donau, and the battle was fought in the flood plain between the river and the mountains. At Dürenstein a combined force of Russian and Austrian troops trapped a French division commanded by Théodore Maxime Gazan.

zh.s: 迪恩施泰因战役（德语：Schlacht bei Dürnstein；也称Dürrenstein、Dürnstein或Diernstein）发生于1805年11月11日，是拿破仑战争第三次反法同盟战争期间的一次战斗。迪恩施泰因（今名Dürnstein）位于奥地利多瑙河畔的瓦豪河谷，距维也纳上游73公里。多瑙河在迪恩施泰因和附近的克雷姆斯之间形成弯月形河段，战斗发生在河流与山脉之间的洪泛平原上。战斗中，俄奥联军包围了泰奥多尔·马克西姆·加赞指挥的法军一个师。

en.s: The Battle of Dürenstein order of battle included a Coalition force of Russian and Austrian troops, under the overall command of Mikhail Kutuzov, and a single division of the Corps Mortier commanded by Édouard Mortier. In pursuing the Austrian retreat from Bavaria, Mortier had over-extended the three divisions of his newly formed VIII. Corps, spreading them along the north bank of the Danube.

zh.s: 1805年11月11日，奥地利杜恩施泰因附近发生战斗。盟军由米哈伊尔·库图佐夫统领的俄国和奥地利部队组成；法军一方是爱德华·莫蒂埃率领的一个师。莫蒂埃追击从巴伐利亚撤退的奥军时，将新组建军团的三个师沿多瑙河北岸拉得过散。

en.s: The Battle of Espinosa de los Monteros was a battle of the Napoleonic Wars, fought on 10 and 11 November 1808 at the township of Espinosa de los Monteros in the Cantabrian Mountains. It resulted in a French victory under General Victor against Lieutenant General Joaquín Blake's Army of Galicia.

zh.s: 埃斯皮诺萨德洛斯蒙特罗斯战役是拿破仑战争期间的一场战斗，于1808年11月10日至11日在坎塔布连山脉的埃斯皮诺萨德洛斯蒙特罗斯镇进行。维克托将军率领法军击败了华金·布莱克中将指挥的加利西亚军团。

en.t: 1816 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: A presidential election was held in Maryland on November 11, 1816, as part of the 1816 United States presidential election. The Democratic-Republican ticket of the U.S. secretary of state James Monroe and the governor of New York Daniel D. Tompkins defeated the Federalist ticket. Although the Federalists failed to nominate a presidential candidate, Federalist unpledged electors carried three single-member districts; the electors chosen from these districts subsequently abstained from the Electoral College vote.

zh.t: 1816年美国总统选举马里兰州选举结果
zh.s: 1816年11月11日，马里兰州举行美国总统选举的一部分投票。民主共和党候选人、美国国务卿詹姆斯·门罗与纽约州州长丹尼尔·汤普金斯组成的竞选组合击败联邦党候选人。联邦党虽未提名总统候选人，但其未承诺支持任何候选人的选举人赢得了3个单一选区；这些选举人后来在选举人团投票中弃权。

en.t: 1824 United States presidential election in New York
en.s: The 1824 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 11, 1824, as part of the 1824 United States presidential election. The state legislature chose 36 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. During this election, the Democratic-Republican Party was the only major national party, and 4 different candidates from this party sought the Presidency.

zh.s: 1824年11月11日，纽约州举行美国总统选举的一部分投票。州议会选出36名代表，即选举人团成员，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。当时民主共和党是唯一主要全国性政党，该党有4名候选人竞选总统。

en.s: The 1833–34 Massachusetts gubernatorial election consisted of a popular election (direct election) held on November 11, 1833, and a legislative vote held in January 1834. The task of electing the governor fell to the Massachusetts General Court because no candidate received the constitutionally required majority of the popular vote. National Republican Governor Levi Lincoln Jr. did not run for a tenth term in office.

en.s: The 1839 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was a tightly contested race won by Marcus Morton. Under Massachusetts law at the time, a majority of the votes cast was required to win, and Morton received exactly half the votes cast. Despite the presence of some irregularities, incumbent Whig governor Edward Everett refused to contest the results once a legislative committee dominated by his party accepted a report giving Morton 51,034 votes out of 102,066 cast.

en.s: Józef Klemens Piłsudski (Polish: [ˈjuzɛf ˈklɛmɛns piwˈsutskʲi] ; 5 December 1867 – 12 May 1935) was a Polish statesman who served as the Chief of State (1918–1922) and first Marshal of Poland (from 1920). en.s: The 1938 Turkish presidential election is the presidential election held in the Grand National Assembly of Turkey on 11 November 1938. The election was held one day after the death of President Mustafa Kemal Atatürk on 10 November 1938. 348 MPs participated in the elections. President İsmet İnönü was unanimously elected president.

en.s: The Battle of Taranto took place on the night of 11–12 November 1940 during the Second World War between British naval forces, under Admiral Andrew Cunningham, and Italian naval forces, under Admiral Inigo Campioni. The Royal Navy launched the first all-aircraft ship-to-ship naval attack in history, employing a small number of obsolescent Fairey Swordfish biplane torpedo bombers from the aircraft carrier HMS Illustrious (R87) in the Mediterranean Sea. The attack struck the battle fleet of the Regia Marina at anchor in the harbour of Taranto using aerial torpedoes despite the shallow depth of the water.

zh.s: 1940年11月11日至12日夜间，第二次世界大战期间，安德鲁·坎宁安海军上将指挥的英国海军与伊尼戈·坎皮奥尼海军上将指挥的意大利海军在塔兰托交战。英国皇家海军发动了历史上首次由舰载飞机实施的舰对舰海上攻击，出动“光辉号”航空母舰上的少量过时费尔雷“剑鱼”双翼鱼雷轰炸机。尽管塔兰托港水浅，英军仍用空投鱼雷袭击了停泊在港内的意大利皇家海军舰队。

en.s: Operation MB 8 was a British Royal Navy operation in the Mediterranean Sea from 4 to 11 November 1940. It was made up of six forces comprising two aircraft carriers, five battleships, 10 cruisers and 30 destroyers, including much of Force H from Gibraltar, protecting four supply convoys. It consisted of Operation Coat, Operation Crack, Convoy MW 3, Convoy ME 3, Convoy AN 6 and the main element Operation Judgement (the Battle of Taranto).

en.s: Presidential, legislative and local elections were held on November 11, 1941 in the Philippines. Incumbent President Manuel Luis Quezon won an unprecedented second partial term as President of the Philippines in a landslide. His running mate, Vice President Sergio Osmeña also won via landslide. The elected officials however, did not serve their terms from 1942 to 1945 due to World War II. In 1943, a Japanese-sponsored Republic was established and appointed Jose P. Laurel as president. From 1943 to 1945, the Philippines had two presidents. Quezon died in 1944 due to tuberculosis and was replaced by Sergio Osmeña.

zh.s: 菲律宾于1941年11月11日举行总统、立法机构和地方选举。现任总统曼努埃尔·路易斯·奎松以压倒性优势胜出，史无前例地开始第二个不完整任期。其竞选搭档、现任副总统塞尔希奥·奥斯梅尼亚也以大幅优势当选。不过，由于第二次世界大战，民选官员未能在1942年至1945年履职。1943年，日本扶植成立菲律宾共和国，并任命何塞·P.·劳雷尔为总统。1943年至1945年间，菲律宾同时有两位总统。奎松于1944年因肺结核去世，奥斯梅尼亚接任。

en.s: Election to the Senate were held on November 11, 1941 in the Philippines. The Senate was re-instituted after amendments to the constitution restored the bicameral legislature last used in 1935. The elected senators would start to serve only in 1946 as they were not able to take office on December 30, 1941 as Imperial Japan invaded the country on December 8, 1941 at the onset of World War II. The electorate voted with plurality-at-large voting with closed lists for the first time for the Senate; the voters would only need to write the party name on the ballot and all 24 candidates from the party receive votes.

zh.s: 菲律宾于1941年11月11日举行参议院选举。宪法修正案恢复两院制后，参议院重新设立；此前上一次采用两院制是在1935年。由于日本于1941年12月8日入侵菲律宾，原定于12月30日就职的当选参议员未能履职，直到1946年才开始任期。这是参议院首次采用封闭名单制的全票制：选民只需在选票上写下政党名称，该党全部24名候选人都会获得选票。

Following the capture of Kokoda by Australian forces on 2 November, the Allies began flying in fresh supplies of ammunition and food to ease the supply problems that had slowed their advance north after the climactic battle around Ioribaiwa, which coupled with reverses elsewhere, had stopped the Japanese advance on Port Moresby.

en.t: The People's Liberation Army Air Force is founded
en.s: The People's Liberation Army Air Force (PLAAF), also known as Chinese Air Force or PLA Air Force is the primary aerial warfare service of the People's Liberation Army. en.s: On November 11, 1960, a failed coup attempt against President Ngô Đình Diệm of South Vietnam was led by Lieutenant Colonel Vương Văn Đông and Colonel Nguyễn Chánh Thi of the Airborne Division of the Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN). en.s: The Action of 11 November 2008 was a naval engagement fought off Somalia between pirates and British forces. Russia has stated that its forces fought off the pirates also, though Russia's involvement has been disputed by the Royal Navy. en.s: Turning Point (2012) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling that took place on November 11, 2012 at the Impact Wrestling Zone in Orlando, Florida. It was the ninth annual Turning Point event and the final one to be broadcast on pay-per-view. Eight matches were featured on the card. The main event consisted of Jeff Hardy successfully defending the TNA World Heavyweight Championship in a Ladder match against Austin Aries. More matches on the uppercard included Kurt Angle defeating Devon, and James Storm defeating A.J. Styles and Bobby Roode to become number one contender to the TNA World Heavyweight Championship.

en.t: Typhoon Vamco makes landfall in Luzon and several offshore islands, killing 67 people. The storm causes the worst floods in the region since Typhoon Ketsana in 2009
en.s: Typhoon Vamco, known in the Philippines as Typhoon Ulysses, was a powerful, deadly, and very destructive Category 4-equivalent typhoon that struck the Philippines and Vietnam in mid-November 2020. It also caused the worst flooding in Metro Manila since Typhoon Ketsana in 2009. The twenty-second named storm and tenth typhoon of the 2020 Pacific typhoon season, Vamco originated as a tropical depression northwest of Palau, where it slowly continued its northwest track until it made landfall in Quezon.

zh.t: 台风凡斯高在吕宋岛及多个近海岛屿登陆，造成67人死亡；该风暴引发该地区自2009年凯萨娜台风以来最严重的洪灾
zh.s: 凡斯高台风在菲律宾称为尤利西斯台风，是一场强劲、致命且破坏力极大的台风，强度相当于四级飓风，于2020年11月中旬袭击菲律宾和越南。它还导致马尼拉大都会地区遭遇2009年凯萨娜台风以来最严重的洪灾。凡斯高是2020年太平洋台风季第22个命名风暴和第10个台风，最初在帕劳西北方发展为热带低压，随后缓慢向西北移动，最终在奎松登陆。

en.s: On 11 November 2022, the Armed Forces of Ukraine liberated and recaptured the city of Kherson and other areas of the Kherson Oblast and parts of the Mykolaiv Oblast on the right bank of the Dnipro River from Russian control. en.s: By-elections were held in Zimbabwe on 11 November 2023, on 9 December 2023, on 3 February 2024 and on 27 April 2024 to fill vacancies in the National Assembly and in local government. The by-elections were triggered by Sengezo Tshabangu, who claimed to be the interim Secretary-General of the Citizens Coalition for Change, when he recalled nine constituency legislators, six proportional representative women’s quota and senators and seventeen councilors mainly from Bulawayo, one of the party's strongholds.

zh.s: 津巴布韦于2023年11月11日、2023年12月9日、2024年2月3日和2024年4月27日举行补选，以填补国民议会和地方政府的空缺。变革公民联盟临时秘书长森格佐·查邦古声称自己有权召回议员，他因此召回了9名选区议员、6名比例代表制妇女配额议员和参议员，以及17名市议员。这些人主要来自该党据点之一布拉瓦约。

en.s: The 2023 Bayelsa State gubernatorial election took place on 11 November 2023 to elect the Governor of Bayelsa State. Incumbent PDP Governor Douye Diri won election to a second term by a 23.6% margin of victory over former Governor Timipre Sylva, the APC nominee. The primaries, scheduled for between 27 March and 17 April 2023, resulted in Diri being renominated by the Peoples Democratic Party unopposed on 12 April while the All Progressives Congress nominated Sylva on 15 April.
